title: Film and TV Tours: Harry Potter, Universal and More
description: Film and TV days out for fans: the Warner Bros. Studio Tours in London and Tokyo, Universal Studios Hollywood, Platform 9¾ and Harry Potter filming locations.
h1: Film and TV tours for fans of all ages
intro: Walk onto real film sets and see how movie magic is made. These tours are a dream day out for film-loving kids and teens.

image.alt: A Platform 9¾ sign for the Hogwarts Express

blocks.title: Scout’s film-fan verdict
blocks.text: Studio tours sell timed tickets that go early for holidays. Book direct on the official site and allow plenty of time.

sections.html: See all our Harry Potter days out, the Studio Tour tips and filming locations.

faqs.q: Where can you see real Harry Potter sets?
faqs.a: At the Warner Bros. Studio Tour London in Leavesden and the Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo.
